summary: Iteration 2 backend regression: re-validated all flows + new endpoints (status, subjects, password-back-to-admin). 27/27 tests passing on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Stores plain-text password in `password_plain` field on the user document so admin can later view it. This is by design per requirements but is a security smell (password leakage if DB is compromised). Consider documenting/limiting access.
Public endpoint exposes ALL profile names + ids + statuses (including admin). Acceptable for the profile-picker UX, but worth noting publicly.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting. Login is unprotected against repeated wrong-password attempts (auth_testing.md mentions 5-fail lockout).

action_items: Optional: add brute-force lockout (5 fails) per auth playbook.
Optional: hide admin from public /api/auth/profiles or only expose alunos.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~590 lines; still single-file but acceptable for current scope. If it grows further, split into routers/auth.py, routers/tasks.py etc.
`password_plain` stored in plaintext alongside bcrypt hash (per spec). Mitigation: never expose via aluno endpoints (currently OK, only admin sees it).
`/api/auth/profiles` is public and returns admin too — fine for picker, but consider filtering to role!=admin if security tightens.
No rate limit / brute-force lockout on /auth/login (auth_testing.md asks for 5-fail lockout).
JWT_SECRET correctly read from env. Cookie flag secure=False is fine for preview env; should be True in production.
Subject duplicate check uses regex `^name$` with `i` option — OK but un-escaped name could break with regex chars. Consider re.escape or simple lower() comparison.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed students/subjects/tasks and clean them up via admin DELETE in fixtures. No persistent test data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is the regression suite (27 tests, all green). It covers: profiles+status, login w/ email & user_id, login blocked for maintenance/blocked statuses, users CRUD (no email, name+password), admin sees plain password & status in GET /api/users, PATCH /api/users/{id}/status (admin only, validates active|maintenance|blocked), subjects (8-default seed + create/delete/dup-case-insensitive), tasks lifecycle (create/list/update/complete idempotent/uncomplete/delete), file upload & download via Bearer + ?auth= query. Use `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Only frontend is left to test in next iterations.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — no failing tests this iteration.
